# teleportconnect_ssh_tunnel (Ephemeral Resource)

Opens a local TCP listener proxied through a Teleport-managed SSH gateway node to an arbitrary host:port reachable from that gateway. In-process equivalent of `tsh ssh -N -L LOCAL:TARGET_HOST:TARGET_PORT GATEWAY`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "teleportconnect_node" "bastion" {
  labels = {
    role = "bastion"
  }
}

# Open a local TCP listener proxied through a Teleport-managed SSH gateway
# node to an arbitrary host:port reachable from that gateway. Equivalent to
# `tsh ssh -N -L LOCAL:internal-db.vpc.local:5432 bastion`.
ephemeral "teleportconnect_ssh_tunnel" "db" {
  gateway_node = data.teleportconnect_node.bastion.matched_hostname
  ssh_login    = "ec2-user"
  target_host  = "internal-db.vpc.local"
  target_port  = 5432
}

# provider "postgresql" {
#   host     = ephemeral.teleportconnect_ssh_tunnel.db.local_host
#   port     = ephemeral.teleportconnect_ssh_tunnel.db.local_port
#   database = "appdb"
#   username = "readonly"
#   sslmode  = "disable"
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_node` (String) Teleport node hostname (or UUID) used as the SSH jump host.
- `ssh_login` (String) OS user to authenticate as on the gateway node (e.g. `root`, `ec2-user`).
- `target_host` (String) Host the gateway node should forward traffic to (DNS name or IP).
- `target_port` (Number) Port on target_host to forward traffic to.

### Optional

- `cluster` (String) Override route_to_cluster (leaf cluster name).
- `ttl` (String) SSH certificate validity (Go duration). Defaults to 1h.

### Read-Only

- `local_host` (String) Localhost address the tunnel is listening on (typically 127.0.0.1).
- `local_port` (Number) OS-assigned local port the tunnel is listening on.
